# Dynasty Futures

> Dynasty Futures is a proprietary trading firm offering simulated funded accounts to qualified futures traders. Traders complete an evaluation challenge on a simulated account, and successful traders receive funded accounts with profit-sharing arrangements.

## What Dynasty Futures Does

Dynasty Futures provides evaluation programs where traders demonstrate their skills on simulated futures accounts. All trading is simulated — traders never trade live capital. The firm offers three plan tiers (Standard, Advanced, Builder) with account sizes of $25,000, $50,000, $100,000, and $150,000.

## Key Facts

- All trading is 100% simulated — no live capital is ever at risk
- Static drawdown model (fixed loss limit, does not trail equity)
- 5-day payout cycles once funded
- Supported platform: Volumetrica with DeepCharts data feed integration
- Copy trading allowed; automated bots are NOT allowed
- No consistency rule on funded accounts
- After 5 payouts: 80/20 profit split (80% to trader)

## Plan Tiers

- **Standard Plan**: Lowest evaluation fee ($49–$149), $80 activation fee after passing, 50% consistency rule during evaluation
- **Advanced Plan**: Higher evaluation fee ($79–$229), no activation fee, no consistency rule
- **Builder Plan**: Highest evaluation fee ($109–$299), no activation fee, higher max loss limit than Standard, 50% consistency rule during evaluation
